message.content:
Here’s a classic set of ingredients you’ll need to make a hearty, traditional lasagna:

| Category | Typical Items |
|----------|---------------|
| **Pasta** | Lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) |
| **Meat Sauce** | Ground beef or a mix of beef & pork; onion; garlic; crushed tomatoes or passata; tomato paste; red wine (optional); dried oregano; dried basil; salt; black pepper; olive oil |
| **Cheese Mixture** | Ricotta cheese; beaten egg (helps bind); grated Parmesan; chopped fresh parsley or basil; salt; pepper |
| **Layering Cheese** | Shredded mozzarella (or a blend of mozzarella & provolone) |
| **Optional Add‑ins** | Sautéed spinach, sliced mushrooms, diced zucchini, or roasted red peppers |
| **Seasoning** | Extra dried oregano, basil, thyme, or a pinch of nutmeg for the ricotta mixture |
| **Topping** | Extra shredded mozzarella and grated Parmesan for a golden crust |

Feel free to adjust quantities based on how many servings you’re aiming for—typically about 1–2 cups of each cheese per layer, and 1–2 cups of meat sauce per layer. Enjoy your cooking!
